info.name: Life Biosciences WordPress Content Posts API
List published posts (press releases and news)

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to posts published after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Limit response to posts modified after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: author
params.description: Limit result set to posts assigned to specific authors.

params.name: author_exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes posts assigned to specific authors.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to posts published before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_before
params.description: Limit response to posts modified before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: search_semantics
params.description: How to interpret the search input.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by post attribute.

params.name: search_columns
params.description: Array of column names to be searched.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to posts with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: status
params.description: Limit result set to posts assigned one or more statuses.

params.name: tax_relation
params.description: Limit result set based on relationship between multiple taxonomies.

params.name: categories
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific terms assigned in the categories taxonomy.

params.name: categories_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific terms assigned in the categories taxonomy.

params.name: tags
params.description: Limit result set to items with specific terms assigned in the tags taxonomy.

params.name: tags_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to items except those with specific terms assigned in the tags taxonomy.

params.name: sticky
params.description: Limit result set to items that are sticky.

params.name: ignore_sticky
params.description: Whether to ignore sticky posts or not.

params.name: format
params.description: Limit result set to items assigned one or more given formats.

items.docs: List published posts (press releases and news). Read-only; served anonymously by the WordPress REST API on the Life Biosciences corporate site.

info.name: Retrieve a single post by id

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the resource.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in response.

params.name: excerpt_length
params.description: Override the default excerpt length.

params.name: password
params.description: The password for the post if it is password protected.
